notes.title: HENTAI MIKA - RELEASED
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33981899/3d51a4f5b00c6d924d560707979581eac36bba69.jpg[/img]

Hentai Mika is a hot puzzle game that fuses erotic flair with Japanese elegance. The main star, Mika, is a teasing samurai babe who's ready to strip — but only for the smartest players.
Every image is a new pose, a fresh vibe, and even more bare skin. Solve puzzles piece by piece and feast your eyes on this fierce beauty's body.

What’s waiting for you in the game:

🔓 30 erotic levels — each one peels more layers off Mika
🏆 30 achievements — track your naughty progress with pride
🖼️ Gallery — save all unlocked images and admire Mika whenever you want

🎮 3 difficulty modes — from cheeky fun to a real brain teaser:
[list]
[*] Easy — for chill players
[*] Medium — for those who like balance
[*] Hard — for the real conquerors
[/list]

Collect, unlock, enjoy — Hentai Mika is more than just a game. It’s a seductive journey into the body and soul of a samurai beauty, and only wit and patience will reveal it all.

notes.title: Full Screen, Full Fun!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217120/806403b1f21db70d211ced9b4d0e8a2262d11788.png[/img]

Hello, dear players!

We’re excited to announce that we’ve released a new update for our game. We’ve put a lot of effort into making your gaming experience even better. Here’s what we’ve prepared for you in this update:

[list]
[*] Updated the main menu.
[*] Added a new section — the gallery.
[*] Integrated an updated game engine.
[*] Introduced three difficulty levels.
[*] Improved game settings.
[*] Implemented support for different screen sizes.
[*] Added full-screen mode.
[*] Added new sound effects.
[/list]

We truly hope you’ll enjoy this update! Thank you for your support and feedback, which motivates us to keep improving. Please share your thoughts — it helps us make the game even more exciting!

Have fun playing!
